lead.claim: Perceptual learning for plantar sensation reduces fall risk in hemiplegia.
lead.context: Why this matters: *This randomized controlled trial examined if adding perceptual learning to plantar hardness discrimination helps hemiplegic stroke patients.*

supporting.claim: Which therapies best manage axillary web syndrome after breast cancer surgery?
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This network meta-analysis compared physical therapies for pain, range of motion, and upper-limb disability in axillary web syndrome.*

supporting.claim: Clinical assessments predict robot-based tracking better than lesion features after stroke.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This pilot study explored how well clinical assessments and lesion features predict robot-based tracking performance in stroke patients.*

supporting.claim: Low-cost interventions increased rehabilitation referrals for acute stroke patients.
supporting.context: This study implemented low-cost interventions based on the COM-B model to increase bed-substitution rehabilitation referrals in acute stroke care.

supporting.claim: Stretching may improve mobility, spasticity, pain, and fatigue in MS.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This systematic review investigated the effects of stretching interventions in people with multiple sclerosis.*
